en.headline: More than 1,500 residents tour the rebuilt Huanggang port
en.dek: The Security Bureau held a community day at the Hong Kong side of the joint checkpoint building ahead of the crossing's opening.
body: More than 1,500 residents from districts across Hong Kong were invited on Sunday to tour the Hong Kong port area of the rebuilt Huanggang joint checkpoint building, the Security Bureau said. The visit was held ahead of the crossing's opening.

Participants first saw the public transport interchange, then walked through the building, including free government Wi-Fi. Immigration officers explained the co-location self-service channels on the fifth-floor departure hall, and customs officers outlined passenger clearance and inspection on the fourth-floor arrival hall. The bureau said the arrangement is a "joint inspection, one release" model.

Secretary for Security Tang Ping-keung inspected the site and spoke with participants. The bureau said many residents responded positively and were looking forward to the port opening, which it said should offer a faster crossing. It said the government would keep working with Shenzhen on preparations.
The bureau said the day also covered the building's design and the public transport links to the port. It did not announce an opening date.

zh.headline: 逾1500名市民參觀重建後皇崗口岸港方口岸區
zh.dek: 保安局在口岸開通前舉辦社區體驗日，讓各區市民試用公共交通安排，並了解「合作查驗、一次放行」通關模式。
body: 保安局表示，重建後的皇崗口岸開通在即，局方星期日舉辦社區體驗日，邀請全港各區逾1500名市民參觀聯檢大樓港方口岸區，先行了解往來口岸的公共交通及大樓設施。
參加者先到公共運輸交匯處，其後參觀大樓室內設計及免費政府Wi-Fi。入境處人員在五樓離境大堂介紹「合作查驗」自助通道，海關人員則在四樓入境大堂講解旅客清關及查驗流程。局方指新安排是「合作查驗、一次放行」。
保安局局長鄧炳強到場視察並與參加者交流。局方說不少市民反應正面，期待口岸早日開通，帶來更快捷的通關。特區政府會繼續與深圳方面準備開通工作。
保安局表示，體驗日亦讓參加者了解聯檢大樓的設計及公共交通安排。局方未有公布正式開通日期。
